purpose: Reconcile bundled content scope with the latest accepted Mac and iOS package evidence. Imported content remains open-ended.

macOS.packageEvidence: Build 86 records no non-localisation resource-index differences from build 85 and reuses selected build 85 engine evidence. The complete build 86 app audit and campaign closure were not rerun.
macOS.status: Published, with bundled engine/content closure still open.

iOS.manifest: Build 8 packages 120 Classic campaign levels and 26 files. Its content validation lists no L2 or L3 mobile library.
iOS.currentSourceStatus: Later 2.0 source connects L2, L3 and supported NeoLemmix import and gameplay paths. No accepted iOS release package for that source is recorded here.
iOS.status: Current source scope is broader than the last accepted iOS package. Do not count source support as bundled release coverage.

classic.scope: 352 official/conversion levels and 6,020 fan levels across 535 fan packs in the Mac bundle evidence.
classic.verified: All 352 official/conversion routes have identity-pinned winning replay evidence. Fan audit has 2,403 verified winning routes, 18 failed candidates, 3,599 rows without matching candidates, and 3,617 levels without verified wins.
classic.open: The Mac fan-level closure gate requires winning routes. The 3,617 missing wins remain open. The older fan load/conversion gate covers load/start and the 60 conversions only.

lemmings2.scope: 120 campaign levels, 70 carry-over variants and 12 continuous tribe chains in the Mac content evidence.
lemmings2.verified: All 120 standalone routes, 70 carry-over variants and 12 chains replay successfully.
lemmings2.open: The chains end with one survivor and a Bronze talisman. Gold Ark completion and source-engine parity remain open.

lemmings3.scope: 90 levels with 416 standalone and carried route fixtures in the current strict audit.
lemmings3.verified: 399 of 416 fixtures pass exact double replay.
lemmings3.open: 17 route fixtures fail. The excavation mask, built-brick trigger, wider Mole rules, environmental effects, movie audio, story transitions and release-package recovery also remain open.

neoLemmix.scope: 794 level files and 26 bundled DMA styles in the published Mac package evidence.
neoLemmix.verified: 719 levels resolve with the bundled styles. Exact-version winning replay evidence covers 158 levels.
neoLemmix.open: 75 bundled levels need 44 community styles. Rights are not cleared. Every level remains in bundled closure scope. Winning-route and source-behaviour coverage remain incomplete.

scopeDecisions: The Classic fan load/start gate and the 60-conversion gate do not close the separate all-bundled-content gate.
The pinned NeoLemmix 1.7 compatibility gate does not close the 2.0 bundled scope. The 75 indexed levels with missing styles remain in scope.
Community styles required by indexed bundled NeoLemmix levels are unresolved bundled dependencies. Do not relabel these levels as imported content.
Player-imported content is outside bundled closure counts. Keep support claims limited by engine, version and tested features.
reason: The published Mac bundle has unresolved route, fidelity, style-rights and source-parity gaps. The last installed iOS candidate does not contain the full 2.0 engine scope, and no accepted full-scope iOS package is recorded.
